MLI.note: AGEFAU projects named are training and touchscreens for administrations, not internet access for rural areas.

facts.fact: AGEFAU, the universal access fund agency, says it funds a 200 million FCFA project to build digital capacity in 126 communes, and reported progress on a 715,709,261 FCFA project to equip governorates with energy-autonomous touchscreens.

systems.owner: AGEFAU with the Ministry of Territorial Administration

MLI.note: Training for 126 communes and touchscreens for governorates are capacity and equipment with no office connection stated.
